name: Web
what: The guide tier showing how to build things on the web, live — nine navigation patterns and seven layout principles, each one clickable and testable.
features: test layout principles at four widths

demos.shows: nine clickable navigation patterns plus two studies
seven layout principles with live toolbars

gaps: does not show how patterns break at extreme widths
blurb: Live guide to web patterns and layout principles.

name: Websites
what: Real websites photographed at four widths and tagged by the layout they use — a corpus of tagged sites with screenshots and live viewers.
features: click tag to see similar layouts

demos.shows: 47 real sites with four-width strips and tags

gaps: does not show how a site's layout fails at other widths
patterns not explicitly named on each site card
section layout pages need manual discovery
blurb: Real sites tagged by layout, shown at four widths.

stage.should_cap: strip scrolls but fits content at 3440

name: Notes
what: Working notes for the team and photographed notebook pages with transcriptions and links to what they turned into on the site.
blurb: Photographed notebook pages, transcribed and linked.

name: Blog
what: A magazine front and blog with articles in framework, systems, and AI sections — real reading layouts with exhibits and a magazine-style index above the fold.

demos.shows: magazine front with featured post and wall of cards

gaps: does not show full post reading experience on front
exhibit column behavior not visible in front
parts of multi-part posts not shown
blurb: Magazine front and blog with reading-width layout.
